name: JustAFriend
source:
The main character immerses himself completely in work, while his girlfriend Lisa stays at home, gradually sinking into boredom.

One day, on the advice of an old friend, she registers on the website JustAFriend — a seemingly harmless decision that quietly sets off a chain of events long before anyone realizes the consequences.

[From [url=https://just-a-friend.itch.io/justafriend]Itch.io[/url]]
